name: io.github.dii/stlink-mcp
title: stlink-mcp
description: Program, run and inspect STM32 targets over ST-LINK; every result verified, unverified or failed.

environmentVariables.name: STLINK_MCP_CLT_ROOT
environmentVariables.description: STM32CubeCLT (or STM32CubeIDE) install directory, when it is not in a standard place

environmentVariables.name: STLINK_MCP_BOARDS
environmentVariables.description: TOML file describing boards this project has not characterised; defaults to ~/.config/stlink-mcp/boards.toml if it exists

environmentVariables.name: STLINK_MCP_NO_VENDOR_SEED
environmentVariables.description: Set to anything to run on measured and user-stated data only, with no seeding from ST's device databases

environmentVariables.name: STLINK_MCP_CONSOLE
environmentVariables.description: Serial console per probe, SERIAL=/dev/ttyUSB0, comma-separated for several; for a console that is not the probe's own

environmentVariables.name: STLINK_MCP_GDB_PORT
environmentVariables.description: First GDB server port; each probe's server takes this port and the next
